result: If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure universal access to quality education. Education is a powerful tool that empowers individuals and communities, reduces inequality, and promotes economic growth. It has the potential to transform lives, break the cycle of poverty, foster understanding and empathy, and create a more informed and engaged global citizenry. Universal access to education would mean that no child would be left behind, regardless of their background, socio-economic status, or location. This, in turn, would create a more just, equitable, and prosperous world for all.
